name: Outdoor Layering

intent_defaults.description: A configurable layering direction for outdoor activities, with user-defined ventilation, mobility and weather requirements.
intent_defaults.silhouette: Layer-compatible regular or relaxed fit with user-controlled ease.

component_defaults.layers: User-defined base, mid and outer layer relationships
component_defaults.pockets: Storage placement based on declared activity

accessibility_defaults: All fit, closure, coverage and material choices remain user-editable.
circularity_defaults: Offer repair, alteration and modular-replacement options where compatible with the wearer intent.
caveats: Weather protection, waterproofness, wind resistance and thermal performance are not established by this preset.
Outdoor suitability must be evaluated for the declared climate, activity and material system.
